summaryText:
Hi,

Here is the end-of-day summary for 8 September 2026.
Total work logged: 10h 55m.

Tickets worked on today:

AEME-6282 — 
  Customers exploited multi-tab checkout to redeem and cancel rewards points on 22 UAE orders. 18 remediated via PC-48490. 4 remain with insufficient GCRM balance — partial redemption script prepared under PC-53503. (45m)

AEME-6499 — 
  Five AE orders reported stuck. Four progressed to COMPLETED. One order AE260812-57849665 remains at SHIPPING_REQUESTED. Parallel investigation launched across Kibana, codebase, DB, and Jira. Awaiting DB state verification and root cause analysis. (35m)

AEME-6540 — 
  Two completed AE orders have clawback processes stuck in RUNNING — Checkout.com declined clawback authorization. No reusable PC ticket exists. Remediation script pending user confirmation to re-trigger clawback payment. (2h 0m)

GMT-19192 — 

GMT-20796 — 
  Investigation in progress — RCA not yet completed. File contains residual EOD generation logs rather than actual investigation findings. Full investigation required to determine root cause and remediation path. (45m)

PC-53768 — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  Investigation in progress — RCA not yet completed. File contains residual EOD generation logs rather than actual investigation findings. Full investigation required to determine root cause and remediation path. (1h 0m)

RT-702249 — 
  Investigation in progress — RCA not yet completed. File contains residual EOD generation logs rather than actual investigation findings. Full investigation required to determine root cause and remediation path. (35m)

SAHME-3357 — 
  14 ZA orders with SMC errors investigated. 11 remediated after SMC team completed mappings. 3 remain — A36 device unmapped, invalid identity document, invalid product ID. All blocked on SMC/Subs side. (1h 0m)

SAHME-3407 — 
  Investigation in progress — RCA not yet completed. File contains residual EOD generation logs rather than actual investigation findings. Full investigation required to determine root cause and remediation path. (1h 15m)

SAHME-3409 — 

SAHME-3421 — 
  Investigation in progress — RCA not yet completed. File contains residual EOD generation logs rather than actual investigation findings. Full investigation required to determine root cause and remediation path. (45m)

SAME-3958 — 
  SA sales report missing affiliate_name and multistore_verificationcode columns. Feature gap — infrastructure exists in type system. Remediation: add @ColumnMethod handlers to SaSalesReport.groovy. PC-53689 created with updated script. (2h 15m)

SAME-3962 — 
  18 SA-region orders with refund failures under investigation. Parallel fan-out launched across Kibana, DB, codebase, and Jira. Sub requesting auto refund re-push or confirmation for manual refund. Awaiting DB verification results.

Open tickets:

PC-53768 [To do] — Script to copy paymentInfo to clawback PaymentTransaction and retrigger ClawbackProcess
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53503 [To do] — Redeem rewards points (partial) for 4 AE orders - AEME-6282
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

PC-53529 [To do] — [SAM-24720] Create DB cleanup cronjobs for SMI cluster
  Todo: Investigation/implementation pending.

SAM-24720 [Code Review] —  Update or create Cronjob for autocleanup
  Todo: Hi ~@email,
   Please find below details : 
SAP incident : https://me.sap.com/cases/002075129500011086542026/overview
Sa

Thanks,
Aryan
